# OfferPSP

> OfferPSP is a private B2B payment infrastructure advisory, provider-matching and introduction service operated by Offerspsp.com (Individual Entrepreneur, Georgia) and presented publicly at offerpsp.com.

Official website: https://offerpsp.com/
Contact: bizdev@offerpsp.com

## Official social profiles

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/offerpsp/
- X: https://x.com/offerpsp
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@offerpsp
- Telegram contact: https://t.me/offerpsp
- Founder on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/borys-kononenko-offerpsp/

## What OfferPSP does

- Collects a company's operating and payment requirements privately.
- Evaluates relevant payment service providers and payment routes.
- Prepares a focused shortlist for the requesting company.
- Coordinates qualified introductions and merchant onboarding conversations.
- Supports cross-border payment infrastructure research across Europe, CIS, the Middle East, Latin America and Asia-Pacific.

## Businesses served

- E-commerce businesses
- Online marketplaces
- SaaS and subscription businesses
- Video game platforms and publishers
- Digital entertainment and esports businesses
- Other cross-border businesses

## Important boundaries

OfferPSP provides and charges for its own B2B research, qualification, matching and introduction services. It does not receive, hold, transfer or settle money belonging to merchants, providers or their customers. Provider availability, onboarding, due diligence and commercial terms are determined by independent providers.

OfferPSP does not publish its provider network, private routes, rates or customer records. Requests are submitted through the private intake at https://offerpsp.com/#request.
